brand_idea: Fragrance as dwelling, presence and memory
required_source_references: One exact front-facing photograph of the named VASA bottle from /VASA Images
Official fragrance label artwork when available
shared_fidelity_lock: Preserve the exact supplied VASA 50 ml bottle: clear heavy rectangular glass, softly bevelled shoulders and lower corners, body approximately 44.9 mm wide by 35.15 mm deep by 57.65 mm high, approximately 61.6 mm including the neck; rounded cup-shaped natural wood cap approximately 40.8 mm diameter by 25.65 mm high; short cylindrical neck; polished warm-gold collar; centered straight ivory paper label; exact official lowercase vāsā wordmark, exact fragrance name, supplied scent icon and 50 ml / 1.7 fl oz line; correct liquid hue and label keyline. Maintain plausible glass thickness, liquid meniscus, refraction, wood grain and contact shadow. Treat generated label text only as a placement proxy and replace it in post with official artwork.
shared_negative_prompt: No copied luxury-house campaign, monogram, emblem, layout, packaging, prop language or recognizable signature motif. No competitor name or logo. No invented VASA crest. No misspelled, mirrored or duplicated label. No cylindrical or elongated generic perfume bottle. No stone, metal or plastic cap. No white cutout halo, sticker edge, levitation without support, fake statistics, fantasy palace, mansion, excessive marble, gold dust, random smoke, floating-petal explosion, generic AI glow, neon, oversaturated teal-orange grade, waxy skin, malformed hands, duplicated fingers, plastic botanicals, excessive blur, clipped cap, clipped bottle base, crushed blacks, blown glass highlights, watermark, UI, caption or superimposed typography.

production_notes.text_policy: No baked website copy. Only authentic physical packaging text may appear.
production_notes.pairing_policy: Generate desktop and mobile as separately composed siblings using the same set, lighting and color grade; do not auto-crop.
production_notes.continuity_policy: Approve A01 first and use it as a secondary style reference for A02-A12.
production_notes.render_target: Photographic realism, high-end commercial retouching, natural microtexture, controlled dynamic range, 2K minimum per delivered crop.

assets.prompt: Create a cinematic luxury fragrance campaign still at blue hour in a high-altitude Himalayan landscape. A real VASA The Night Lingers 50 ml bottle stands on one dark weathered slate plinth after light rain. The landscape is expansive, quiet and plausible: layered mountain silhouettes, cool mineral mist and a restrained band of late burgundy light at the horizon. The amber liquid and warm-gold collar catch one narrow saffron highlight; the natural wooden cap remains tactile and dry. The bottle is optically sharp with believable glass refraction while the mountains retain visible structure rather than becoming a blurry backdrop. Compose with architectural calm, large negative space and a single visual hierarchy. The image should feel photographed on location with a medium-format camera, subtle film grain, deep LEATHER shadows, PINE stone, SILK horizon and controlled MUSK highlights. No people, no decorative ingredients, no surreal levitation. Apply the shared bottle and label fidelity lock.
